headline: Nevish Line Leads Renewed Front-Line Movement
war_summary: The latest ledger finds the fighting more sharply gathered along a few unsettled sectors. Nevish Line has risen from 47 to 57 base events in 24 hours, with 12 recorded in the latest two hours and Princefal, Blackcoat Way, and Grief Mother still the chief trouble spots. Weathered Expanse remains a major furnace at 52 daily events; seven came in the last two hours, while Crow’s Nest and Shattered Advance account for much of the movement. Kuura Strand has climbed from 33 to 38 events, chiefly around Faden Point and Talven, though its immediate two-hour tally is quiet. Marban Hollow holds at 32 daily events but has gone still across the latest six hours after earlier action at Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall. Linn Mercy remains at 11 events, with Lathair no longer reporting fresh activity. Stlican Shelf records a smaller three-event disturbance at Breaker Town, while Godcrofts has six events in the day. Callahan’s Passage still carries heavy casualties, but its battle tempo is cooling and no base events are recorded. No victor is declared.
